atoms.b: The zoetrope is an old-fashioned ((animation)) machine.
atoms.sound: The zoetrope is an old-fashioned ((animation)) machine.

atoms.b: The machine shows pictures in different stages of ((movement)).
atoms.sound: The machine shows pictures in different stages of movement.

atoms.b: Zoetropes work by spinning. The ((rotation)) of the machine makes the pictures blur together, creating a film.
atoms.sound: Zoetropes work by spinning. The rotation of the machine makes the pictures blur together, creating a film.

atoms.b: The brain is slower than film, so you can give the brain lots of similar ((information)) and it blends it all together.
atoms.sound: The brain is slower than film, so you can give the brain lots of similar ((information)) and it blends it all together.

atoms.b: You couldn’t watch these films in the ((darkness)) like films today. You needed light to see the pictures.
atoms.sound: You couldn’t watch these films in the darkness like films today. You needed light to see the pictures.

atoms.b: The early ((development)) of film means that these days, we can watch amazing films at the cinema.
